name: ablation-a2prime-spend-matched
title: Add the spend-matched A2-prime arm + token/wall-clock + agentCallCount accounting to the recovery runner
description: The pre-registered five-arm ablation defines A2-prime as compute-matched on token + wall-clock SPEND (explicitly not call count), with a plus-or-minus 20 percent tolerance band, hard truncation, and per-run budget logging. The recovery runner implements neither this arm nor spend accounting. Add token+wall-clock+agentCallCount recording and the spend-matched A2-prime arm so the powered ablation can fairly isolate structure from raw compute.
